messages:
matt: :rotating_light: multiple customers reporting 504s after the rollout at ~10:22 UTC. spike in gateway timeouts and 5xx. noticed in hosted inference routes. anyone oncall?
elaine: seeing the same in dashboards — 99p latency up and a wave of 504s from model-proxy -> auth-service. traces show long waits on token fetch.
oncall-sre: I'm on it. canary slice 3 looks worst. starting rollback for slice=3 now. /rollout rollback --slice=3
deploy-bot: @oncall-sre triggered rollback for release v2026.03.15-canary (job 8675309). status: in_progress.
jordan-support: copying repro from customer: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" \
  -d '{"prompt":"<long prompt>","max_tokens":1024}' -v
# response: HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout\n
```
ashley-eng: looking at the canary config diff — someone flipped `kvcache_prefetch_ttl` 30 -> 5s in the rollout. that would increase auth token calls and backend pressure. reverting that flag now.
oncall-sre: rollback for slice=3 completed. traffic shifted back to baseline. monitoring: 5xx rate trending down.
matt: confirm customers returned to green? need quick customer-facing note.
jordan-support: Customer A confirms reduced 504s after ~2m post-rollback. updating ticket.
elaine: grabbing traces for the affected canary instances (trace ids: trx-9a7, trx-9a8). saving logs to /var/logs/incidents/1758001234/*. collecting sampling of model-proxy logs with timestamps around 1758001200-1758001300.
ashley-eng: pushing a hotfix PR to prevent TTL regression and add a canary metric for auth qps. also adding a temporary guard in rollout tooling to warn on TTL < 10s for this service.
oncall-sre: rolling forward the remaining slices with TTL reverted and monitoring. no sign of 5xx reappearance after 12m.
matt: nice work. please attach timeline + customer impact (which seats affected) to the runbook. assign postmortem to eng-runtime + support.
jordan-support: done — updated ticket and informed customers. will add a short blameless summary.
elaine: will post extracted spans and a dashboard snapshot to the incident doc.
ashley-eng: follow-up: add unit/integ test for prefetch TTL and a lint rule for canary config diffs.
oncall-sre: closing operational incident thread once postmortem ID created. good recovery — keep watch next 24h. :thumbsup:
matt: thx everyone, filing postmortem and action items.
notes: rollback resolved customer-facing 504s; root cause was TTL misconfig causing cache thrash and increased auth QPS
